claim_boundary: IR + cost model + validation of a heterogeneous PhysicalGraph. No real transport, no FPGA board, no discrete GPU, no bitstream, no interconnect measurement. Every cost is labeled COST_MODEL. HARDWARE_MEASURED is refused at Cost construction. GPU_UMA and NPU domains are physical=True (devices present on this host); their interconnect numbers remain COST_MODEL knobs. FPGA_HBM is declared, physical=False. Backend capability tiers are reported separately and are not merged into the plan tier.
hardware_measurement: none. No measured hardware claim is produced anywhere in this lane.
rule: no hardware measurement claim without hardware

roadmap.15.8: Semantic transport: payload semantics, in-transit transforms, and now an explicit ordering ladder parallel to coherency
roadmap.16.1: PRESENT != VALID != TRUSTED; READBACK CORRECTNESS DOES NOT PROVE DEVICE-COMPUTE VISIBILITY (unchanged)
roadmap.16.2: Coherency ladder 0-6 plus explicit NONE; never claim rung 6 across domains (unchanged, not regressed)
roadmap.20: Physical Graph Compiler gene card: the graph now expresses and validates computation, storage, state, scheduling, backend placement, semantic transport, synchronization, fusion, resource requirements
roadmap.30: M3 Ultimate heterogeneous computer: GPU_UMA + NPU + declared FPGA_HBM as one plan; CUDA remains named, not instantiated
roadmap.83: DEVICE-NEUTRAL FIRST: generic layer has no vendor-keyed control flow; backends bind products to DomainKind

hcli/physical_graph.py.provided: Provider-neutral PhysicalGraph (computation/data/representation/memory/residency/state/precision/dependencies/device_placement/synchronization). compile_physical_graph emits PLAN_ONLY graphs. apply_architecture_atlas projects atlas primitives. score_physical_candidates ranks measured complete useful work. NOT a typed inter-domain transport edge, NOT a coherency/ordering validator, NOT a multi-domain schedule.
hcli/physical_graph.py.touched: READ only. compile_heterogeneous_physical_graph calls compile_physical_graph and overlay_physical_graph copies the dict.

tools/odyssey/physical_graph_compiler.py.provided: Source graph -> organ graph -> physical operator graph, with numerical collapse checks (gate_up_swiglu, router top-k). attach_heterogeneous_plan() was a pure dict rewrite that appended a DAG stage. main() still requires checkpoint weights.
tools/odyssey/physical_graph_compiler.py.added: compile_heterogeneous_physical_graph(), validate_heterogeneous_plan(), refusal_cases(). These CALL three_domain_plan, validate, reject_unguaranteed_ordering, kind_admits, resources_fit, enumerate_backends, overlay_physical_graph, compile_physical_graph. main() and organ-collapse measurements are unchanged.

tools/accelerator/semantic_transport.py.provided: ExecutionDomain, DomainKind GPU_UMA/CPU/NPU/FPGA_HBM, DomainVisibility, CoherencyAssumption including explicit NONE, SemanticTransportEdge (payload, ownership, sync, coherency_assumption vs link_coherency, COST_MODEL). Cost construction refuses any label other than COST_MODEL. assumes_stronger_than_link is the coherency overclaim property.
tools/accelerator/semantic_transport.py.added: OrderingGuarantee ladder (NONE/FENCE/ACQUIRE_RELEASE/PRODUCER_CONSUMER), ordering_from_sync, SemanticTransportEdge.ordering_assumption, provided_ordering, assumes_unguaranteed_ordering, ownership_handoff_unguaranteed. Construction still allows illegal plans; the validator refuses them.

tools/accelerator/placement.py.provided: Node-to-domain Placement (COMPUTATION/STATE/STORAGE) with ResourceRequirements and ValidityCondition. kind_admits is uniformly True. Distinct from fusion_planner.Placement (object-home). No product branch.
tools/accelerator/placement.py.touched: READ. Compiler and fusion-bridge validator CALL kind_admits and resources_fit.

tools/accelerator/fusion_bridge.py.provided: HeterogeneousPlan, validate/compose, two_domain_plan (host GPU_UMA + declared FPGA_HBM), overlay_physical_graph, plan_to_timeline, lower_fpga_domain_to_hwir. Validator rejected COHERENCY_OVERCLAIM, HARDWARE_UMA_ACROSS_DOMAINS, READBACK_IS_NOT_COMPUTE_VISIBILITY, COST_LABEL_REFUSED, RESOURCES_EXCEED_CAPACITY. Two domains only. No ordering gate, no ownership-handoff gate, no schedule, no fusion region.
tools/accelerator/fusion_bridge.py.added: ScheduleConstraint, FusionRegion, plan_facets/missing_facets, host_npu_domain, declared_three_domain_topology, three_domain_plan (>=3 domains), reject_unguaranteed_ordering (MUTATION_POINT), _reject_ownership_overclaim, plan_assuming_unguaranteed_ordering, plan_assuming_unguaranteed_ownership. validate() still calls _reject_coherency_overclaim (not regressed) and now also the ordering and ownership gates. two_domain_plan is unchanged as the CLI happy path.

tools/odyssey/fusion_bridge_adapter.py.added: three_domain_plan import and three_domain_is_valid() call site.

tools/accelerator/backend_contract.py.provided: CPU/METAL/ANE/FPGA-HWIR behind one Backend interface. CUDA named, not registered. FPGA cannot emit HARDWARE_MEASURED. enumerate_backends() is the call site.
tools/accelerator/backend_contract.py.touched: READ. Compiler _backend_bindings() CALLS enumerate_backends, capabilities, execution_domain and binds by DomainKind, not product name.

tools/accelerator/fusion_planner.py.provided: Topology/Link/Route, object-home Placement, place_objects. Costs stamped MEASURED/SIMULATED from hop.physical.
tools/accelerator/fusion_planner.py.connected: declared_three_domain_topology reuses Topology; lift_object_placements still wraps place_objects. All three-domain links are physical=False so planner provenance stays SIMULATED and fusion-bridge still labels COST_MODEL.

tools/accelerator/fusion_isa.py.provided: Fourteen-command ISA and FusionTimeline. plan_to_timeline already emits ACQUIRE/COPY/FENCE/SUBMIT/RELEASE.
tools/accelerator/fusion_isa.py.touched: READ. Existing two-domain timeline test still passes; three-domain plan still lowers FPGA placements to HWIR.

gaps_closed: a heterogeneous plan across >= 3 domains (GPU_UMA, NPU, FPGA_HBM) constructs and validates
the graph expresses computation, storage, state, scheduling, backend placement, semantic transport, synchronization, fusion, resource requirements, and missing_facets() is empty on the happy path
a plan that assumes FENCE across a non-coherent link whose requested protocol is NONE is refused (ORDERING_OVERCLAIM)
a plan that assumes SOFTWARE_MANAGED coherency across a link declared NONE is still refused (COHERENCY_OVERCLAIM; not regressed)
exclusive TRANSFER with no happens-before on a NONE link is refused (OWNERSHIP_OVERCLAIM)
reject_unguaranteed_ordering is a call site in fusion_bridge.validate and in physical_graph_compiler.validate_heterogeneous_plan, not an import-only symbol
generic layer (semantic_transport, placement, fusion_bridge) has no vendor-keyed control flow
FPGA stays COST_MODEL; CUDA stays named, not instantiated

fusion.justification: intermediates not observable outside the region; placement is COST_MODEL

gpu_uma_0.note: device present; this interpreter has no mlx dispatch, so the backend capability tier is FUNCTIONAL_SIM. Not merged into the plan COST_MODEL tier.

npu_0.note: NPU present; execute in this interpreter is FUNCTIONAL_SIM. Not merged into the plan COST_MODEL tier.

demo_plan.cuda: named in backend_contract; not registered; not in this plan

refusal_cases.assumption: happens-before FENCE across a non-coherent link whose requested protocol is NONE (no barrier). The schedule and the edge both assume an ordering the transport does not guarantee.
SOFTWARE_MANAGED coherency across a link declared NONE. A non-coherent link must never be assumed coherent.
exclusive OwnershipTransfer.TRANSFER on a NONE-coherent link with SyncRequirement.NONE: the handoff has no happens-before, so both ends can believe they hold exclusive write.
